description: This file defines a generic interface IReadRepository<T> for read-only data access operations, extending a base interface IReadRepositoryBase<T>. It is part of the application core interfaces, providing an abstraction for repository pattern implementations, likely to be used throughout the application for querying entities that implement IAggregateRoot.

classes.name: IReadRepository
classes.description: A generic interface for read-only repository operations, extending IReadRepositoryBase for entities of type T that are classes implementing IAggregateRoot.
